name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
